posts.caption:
Day 3 ✅
-
WU: P9 
Race 2: P8
-
More points on the board here in Magny-Cours! 
-
A tricky one to end our weekend in France. I was excited lining up P4 on the grid and had a good start to the race. However, a bit disappointed after making another couple of costly mistakes and getting outmuscled in a few areas to lose the front group. 
-
Although it wasn’t the best finish, if you would’ve said I’d be disappointed with a top 10 finish at the start of this year I would rip your arm off 😂. Great progress from myself and the team, thank you for the hard work and keeping pushing forwards @phrperformance
-
Onto Cremona… 🇮🇹

Saturdays recap 🤩
-
P4 for the grid today. We are ready 🔥

Day 2 ✅ 
-
WU: P9 
Race 1: P8 
-
Happy with today’s efforts and more points on the board! Not the best of starts but managed to close a big gap to the front group after the start. Felt I had the pace to push up to the top 5, but just made too many mistakes to reach them. 
-
Everything is in a good place, some good lap times and the bike is feeling good. Lining up P4 on the grid for tomorrow and looking forward for it 💪🏻
-
Big thank you to my pair Leon & Daniel, we’re building the right foundations and learning each session 🙌🏻. 
-
Massive congrats to @fentonseabright73 for the race win, well deserved 💪🏻.
